structured_output.summary: The change follows StringPaddingBuiltinsImpl and StringPad step by step, in spec order. Observable operations happen in the right order: RequireObjectCoercible, ToString(this), ToLength(maxLength), the length check, then fillString handling. Errors propagate with `?`. The empty-fill check comes before the engine length limit, so empty fills still return the string unchanged. Values are rooted correctly around the user-code conversions. The gate report shows 26 of 26 target tests passing, with no regressions. The only judgement call is the RangeError for results over about 2^29 code units. That is a conventional implementation limit, and the spec sets no such limit, so I accepted it.
